architecture.scope: Elbrus/E2K platform research, CPU/toolchain identity tracking and evidence-matrix advisory.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Offline host-side research tools; target claims require toolchain, emulator or physical hardware evidence.
architecture.composition_rule: Compose evidence records and qualification stages as data; target-specific probes must be independently implemented, reviewed and verified.

components.responsibility: Track CPU model, stepping, board revision and toolchain identity.
Represent host, cross-build, emulator and physical-target evidence.
Report coverage and next evidence stage without probing hardware.
Physical E2K boot and hardware qualification.

preserved_boundaries: Host evidence, cross-build, emulator and physical-target evidence are distinct.
The advisor does not probe hardware or infer CPU identity.
E2K-specific behavior is not inferred from x86, Arm or RISC-V.
forbidden_composition: No claim of completed E2K native implementation without target evidence.
No host test presented as hardware qualification.
No fabricated compiler, stepping or board capability values.
gaps: Collect target compiler/version and CPU/board identity from real E2K systems.
Attach reproducible cross-build, emulator and physical-target logs before advancing maturity.
